καί τινές σὺν αὐταῖς. (kai tines sun autais) 'and certain with them.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἐστε (este) 'you are' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἐστάθησαν (estathēsan) 'they stood still' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Ἰησοῦς (Iēsous) 'Jesus' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ ἀπὸ μελισσίου κηρίου. (kai apo melissiou kēriou) 'and from honeycomb tablet.' is only in traditional manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz)
μου (mou) 'of mine' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
καὶ οὕτως ἔδει (kai houtōs edei) 'and thus it was necessary for' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ (kai) 'and' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of εἰς (eis) 'to' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+WH)
αἰνοῦντες καὶ (ainountes kai) 'praising and' is only in traditional manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz)
ἀμήν¶ (amēn) 'Amen' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
